subject: Reserved GPU rollout playbook & procurement path
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cygnus.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Reserved GPU rollout playbook & procurement path

Samir — thanks for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Summary of what we heard (pain & goals):
- Pain: model latency and cost volatility in production; current infra shared with other ML teams leads to noisy neighbors during peak batch scoring.
- Goal: predictable per-inference latency <= 120ms p50 for 1024-token runs, stable monthly unit cost within a 10% band, and isolation from other tenants for PHI workloads.

What Redwood proposes (high level):
1) Dedicated reserved pool (4x A100-equivalent slots to start) with tenant isolation and network controls (VPC peering + egress whitelist).
2) Autoscale buckets: baseline capacity (2 GPUs) for steady traffic + burst pool for periodic jobs. We’ll provide an ops runbook for burst activation and fallback to a lower-cost model if capacity is exhausted.
3) SLA targets: 99.5% availability for the reserved pool, 95th percentile latency SLOs published per model variant; escalation playbook for multi-region failover.

Immediate asks from Cygnus (from call):
- Procurement timeline and preferred PO/contract routing (procurement@cygnus.ai)
- Expected go-live window: target Oct 2027 for pilot (2 GPU steady state)
- Any compliance checklist items beyond SOC2 (e.g., data residency)

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Vivek: share a first-draft rollout playbook + SLA table (attached) — by EOD Wed 2027-08-04.
- Jordan: scope of ops playbook and on-call escalation mapping — draft by 2027-08-06.
- Samir + procurement: confirm commercial contact and PO cadence; share procurement checklist — by 2027-08-06.

I attached the playbook PDF and a sample procurement checklist to speed review. If the timeline looks ok, we’ll schedule a 30-minute procurement alignment with your finance/procurement team next week.

Thanks again — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Dedicated Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cygnus.ai>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, procurement@cygnus.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reserved GPU rollout playbook & procurement path

Vivek — appreciate the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Procurement: procurement@cygnus.ai is the right inbox; primary contact is Maria Cruz (maria.cruz@cygnus.ai). She prefers a one-page commercial summary + SOW and then a formal PO.
- Timeline: Oct pilot window works, but finance needs final numbers by 2027-08-20 to sign off for Q4 budget.
- Compliance: we need a short note on data residency options (us-east vs eu-west) for the pilot and confirmation that KV cache keys will not persist outside the reserved pool. Also want an inventory of logs retained and retention windows for audit.

I’ve looped in procurement. Maria — can you confirm the PO cadence and any required vendor forms?

Samir
Lead ML Engineer, Cygnus Therapeutics

Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 16:52:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Reserved GPU rollout playbook & procurement path — playbook v1 attached

Maria / Samir — forwarding the draft playbook and checklist. Key callouts inside the doc:
- Isolation model: network + tenant-level file system isolation, no shared KV persistence across tenants.
- Autoscale policy: two-tier buckets with warm-start for the burst pool to keep cold-starts < 300ms for small-scale bursts.
- Pricing: baseline reserved hourly + burst metering; we’ll provide a TCO projection once you share expected qps and batch windows.

Maria — quick asks to help us prepare the SOW:
1) Preferred billing entity and PO reference format
2) Are there vendor onboarding forms (W-9 / tax forms / vendor risk questionnaire) we should expect?
3) Desired pilot acceptance criteria (SLA thresholds + test cases)

I attached: redwood-dedicated-rollout-playbook-v1.pdf and a procurement checklist spreadsheet to this thread.

Best — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Dedicated Solutions
Redwood Inference

- Call out a runbook owner on our side (Ops: Neha) with a 24/7 escalation on-call rotation.
